# Mortgage (`mortgage` v1)

A residential mortgage: balance, rate, loan-to-value, amortisation and arrears.

**Group:** Retail banking · **Mnemonic:** `MTG` · **Identifiers:** `MTG-…` in `loanId`

Open one with `MTG <id>`.

```sutra
sutra: mortgage
version: 1
description: "A residential mortgage: balance, rate, loan-to-value, amortisation and arrears."
match: { kind: mortgage, priority: 10 }
title: { pill: Retail banking · Mortgage, id: $.loanId }
strip:
  - { label: Borrower, bind: $.borrowerName }
  - { label: Balance, bind: $.balance, fmt: amount0, emphasis: true }
  - { label: Rate, bind: $.rate, fmt: pct2 }
  - { label: LTV, bind: $.ltv, fmt: pct0 }
  - { label: Remaining term (y), bind: $.remainingYears, fmt: amount0 }
  - { label: Days past due, bind: $.daysPastDue, fmt: amount0 }
panels:
  - id: amortisation
    kind: line
    title: Scheduled balance
    key: F2
    rows: $.amortisation
    x: year
    y: balance
    fmt: compact
  - id: property
    kind: kv
    title: Property
    key: F3
    area: right
    rows: $.property
  - id: payments
    kind: table
    title: Last payments
    key: F4
    rows: $.payments
    columns:
      - { label: Due, bind: "@.due", fmt: date }
      - { label: Amount, bind: "@.amount", fmt: amount2 }
      - { label: Paid, bind: "@.paid", fmt: date }
      - { label: Status, bind: "@.status", tone: status }
  - { id: built, kind: provenance, title: How this view was built }
  - { id: refs, kind: links, title: Linked entities, code: REFS, area: right }
keys: { F7: "link($.customer, 'customer')", F8: impact, F9: raw }
```
